result.rationale: The finding is accurate and grounded: the diff replaces the in-memory SiteSetting check (`SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?`) with `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` in `ensure_embeddable`, which calls `record_for_host` → `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` — a per-request DB query with no cache and no index on `lower(host)`. The migration only creates the table without an index. This is a real, specific performance/architecture concern on a high-traffic endpoint, not a correctness defect (the behavior is correct), so it fits important_non_bug.

judged_text: ensure_embeddable now runs an uncached SQL query on every request (`EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` → `where("lower(host) = ?").first`, unindexed on `lower(host)`), replacing a check that previously read an in-memory site setting. Every /embed/comments and /embed/count request — one per article page-view iframe for forums using embedding — now pays a per-request query plus ActiveRecord instantiation (`record_for_host` returns `.first` where `exists?` would suffice) on one of the highest-traffic endpoints, with no caching layer in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` from checking `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?(request.referer)` to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` calls `record_for_host`, which performs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), i.e., a DB query plus AR object instantiation on each request. The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` or `lower(host)` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), so the concern about unindexed `lower(host)` and per-request querying is grounded. This is a performance/architecture issue rather than a functional defect verifiable from the diff.
